result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it much easier for people to understand each other.

Not just sharing facts, but truly listening to different perspectives, checking assumptions, and recognizing that disagreement doesn’t have to mean hostility. A lot of suffering, conflict, and broken systems come from misunderstanding — and if that barrier were weaker, so many other problems might become easier to solve.
